company.introduction: DCC supplies energy products and services through distribution businesses serving domestic, commercial and industrial customers. Its energy activities include liquid gas, transport and heating fuels, electricity-related solutions and services that help customers manage energy use. Distribution networks, local customer relationships and dependable delivery are important to its model. Revenue comes from product sales and associated services, with results influenced by volumes, product margins and operating efficiency. The group has been reshaping its portfolio around energy, so business disposals and investment decisions also matter. Weather, customer activity and the pace of changes in heating and transport technology affect demand across its markets.

annualReportAnalysis.methodology: Keyword rates are mentions per 10,000 extracted words. Until lexical tone is available, positivity is a labelled proxy comparing year-on-year growth-theme density with pressure/risk-theme density; it is not management guidance or a recommendation.

components.label: Press sentiment
components.detail: Recency-weighted average of 50 scored days in the latest 90 calendar days; 30-day half-life.

components.label: Emerging themes
components.detail: Change in growth-theme density compared with pressure and risk themes.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
